paragraphs.text: He shows that God was ready to help at need and that there was no other way to be saved, but by this means alone.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: So unable were we to resist.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: He uses proper similitudes to express the great danger that the Church was in, and out of which God miraculously delivered them.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: For the wicked not only furiously rage against the faithful, but craftily imagined to destroy them.
paragraphs.label: d
